usageNote: 名词短语，聊自助餐或菜单时超好用！比说'many kinds of food'更地道更有品位感✨

examples.en: The buffet offers a good variety of food from different countries.
examples.zh: 这个自助餐提供来自不同国家的丰富多样食物。

examples.en: I love this restaurant because it has a good variety of food for everyone.
examples.zh: 我喜欢这家餐厅，因为它有适合所有人的各种美食。
